Keyframe prompt (what the still should show)
widgets_values: Image 1 is a blurred colour guide made from a photo of a pet. Make a portrait photo of an invented human character with the same colors and personality: an invented adult whose hair colour echoes the main colours of image 1 and whose clothes echo its other colours, in a similar setting and light. A fully human face with human ears, a human nose and smooth bare human skin. A natural friendly expression. An ordinary invented person with an original face. A head-and-shoulders portrait of one person alone. Photorealistic, vertical portrait framing, high detail, a clean unmarked photo.

nodes.title: Wipe mask (preset asset, made by the builder)
Reveal: wipe from your photo into the effect
About this workflow
widgets_values:
# Pet to Human

Your pet as an invented human character with the same colors and personality; then they look at the camera and grin. With a before/after reveal.

FreeField preset `pet-to-human-studio`. Runs on a 24 GB GPU (studio profile: Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B). Open weights only.

## Fill in
- A clear photo of your pet: the node **Your photo (preset input)**

## Stages, left to right
- 1\. Your photo
- 2\. Transform (FLUX.2 klein 4B)
- 3\. Animate (Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B, studio profile)
- 4\. Reveal (masked composition)
- Save

## Models
- `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors`
- `qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors`
- `flux2-vae.safetensors`
- `umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors`
- `wan_2.1_vae.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_high_noise.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors`
- `wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_low_noise.safetensors`

## What happens
This graph makes the finished video.

## Run it
1. Install this workflow's files into ComfyUI's input folder: `python3 scripts/install_workflow_assets.py --url http://127.0.0.1:8188 pet-to-human-studio`
2. Pick your file in the input node above and press Run.

This is a draft preset: it is not in the FreeField gallery yet, and its files are in `freefield/presets/_drafts/pet-to-human-studio/`. Run it here in ComfyUI.
